text: The Nov. 2 edition reported that Andrew James Crenshaw Jr. was booked on a charge of failure to appear on a felony, as the jail roster showed when it was read. The roster now lists his booked charge as burglary of a residence with force.

The Oct. 26 edition counted 132 non-immigration jail bookings for Oct. 19–25. A full re-read of the roster found one booking missed in transcription; the correct count is 133, 94 of them by the sheriff's office.
